summary.text: Carl Ford is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 33, covering Rowan and Stanly counties, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Gary Weart.
He served in the North Carolina House from 2013 to 2019 and is the Senate Republican Joint Caucus Leader.

paragraphs.text: Ford represented District 76 in the North Carolina House of Representatives from 2013 to 2019.
He took office in the Senate on January 1, 2019, succeeding Cathy Dunn.
The General Assembly's website lists Ford as Senate Republican Joint Caucus Leader.

He chairs the Appropriations on General Government and Information Technology, Pensions and Retirement and Aging, and State and Local Government committees and co-chairs the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on General Government.
The Republican primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
